title: Lecture 1 - RAG Fundamentals
content: RAG combines retrieval and generation. The retrieval component fetches relevant chunks from an external knowledge base before answer generation.

title: Lecture 2 - Agent Workflow
content: Agent workflows can include routing, tool usage, and memory. LangGraph represents the workflow as a stateful directed graph.

title: Tutorial - Evaluation Metrics
content: For system evaluation, include at least one quality metric and one efficiency metric. Compare baseline and ablation variants fairly.
